title: Merge Pisces from the Ocean!
description: A game with an underwater atmosphere! Compete with friends and colleagues! In the game you have a game zone where fish fall and connect if they have the same color! Connect as many fish as possible to get the biggest one, collect points! Become the first on the leaderboard! Play and relax!
instructions: 1 At first it will be easy to connect the fish but over time there will be more and more of them
